description: This file implements the RedisMembershipTable class, which manages clustering membership data in Redis for Orleans. It provides methods for initializing, reading, updating, deleting, and cleaning up membership entries, utilizing Redis hash operations and transactions.

classes.name: RedisMembershipTable
classes.description: Implements IMembershipTable to manage cluster membership in Redis, including initialization, read/write operations, and cleanup.

methods.name: DeleteMembershipTableEntries
methods.description: Deletes all membership table entries for a given cluster ID.

methods.name: InitializeMembershipTable
methods.description: Initializes the Redis connection and optionally sets the initial table version.

methods.name: InsertRow
methods.description: Inserts a membership entry into the Redis membership table.

methods.name: UpsertRowInternal
methods.description: Performs an internal upsert operation with conditions to handle versioning and insert-only constraints.

methods.name: ReadAll
methods.description: Reads all membership entries and the current table version from Redis.

methods.name: ReadRow
methods.description: Reads a specific membership entry identified by a SiloAddress.

methods.name: UpdateIAmAlive
methods.description: Updates the IAmAliveTime property of a membership entry.

methods.name: UpdateRow
methods.description: Updates a membership row with a new entry and version etag.

methods.name: CleanupDefunctSiloEntries
methods.description: Removes entries for silos that are not active and have timed out.
